Coverage

This table shows EuroLeague domestic coverage: only completed/verified games are included.
Sources: official ACB Live, LBA game pages, Israel Basketball game-zone pages, ABA League, LKL and ESAKE/GBL data where available. Other games use Rezultati.com/Flashscore game-level box scores because the official box scores are not publicly accessible; minutes and shots are captured, while PIR/RANK is estimated from available stats with the foul components omitted. Games with only a verified final score are marked as result-only and no player rows are fabricated. Cup and Super Cup games are marked separately from league games. Times are shown in Central European Time (CET/CEST).
